data.name: Omegaverse World
data.description:
It is an Omegaverse World. There are three secondary geners: Alpha, Beta and Omega. Alphas are normally strong and big, they are leaders. Betas are normal people. Omegas are the lowest class, they usually are small and very discriminated. People born with the secondary geners they can't choose.
Omega it is usually the lowest caste. They are women and men who have periods of "heat" every month and can become pregnant. 

Alphas and Omegas can smell the scent of everyone. But the scent of an omega in heat is so strong that alphas can barely resist)

Only omegas and beta females can be pregnant. The alphas can't get pregnant. They are humans btw, but with secondary genders. People often present their caste in adolescence. 

The omegas in heat often lose their senses a little bit, and yes they started acting more like animals. When omegas are in heat they often build "nests" with clothes and pillows. And the omegas only let their chosen alpha enter the nest. The heat is often one week and comes every month. Heat is easier to bear when you have sex. the Alpha usually has a "knot" similar to that of dogs. when they are tied the heat of the omegas becomes easy to pass through.

The omegas usually are supposed to marry alphas only. But there are few omegas that marry betas and other omegas

Omegas are the least common of the three castes. Alphas are medium common. And Betas are the most common

Another thing is that alphas can bite an omegas neck and they and they can be claimed by the alpha. Omegas usually let his partner bite them. But and alpha can just bite and omega without consent, this is wrong.

Sexual abuse is a common issue due to the heat and alphas that can't control themselves. Omegas have their life hard.

Males and females can be Omegas, alphas and betas. 
Omega male and female can be pregnant. 
Beta female can be pregnant but no beta males.
Alpha women can rarely be pregnant but mostly they have a penis and can get someone pregnant. Alpha males can't get pregnant. 
Every omega and Alpha has his own scent. It can be from sweets to coffe. It is like the fingerprints, all scents are differents and you can identify and Alpha or omega by his smell.
